lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; same disagreement as the earlier rulings on this line. f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "If you are an individual, an estate, or a trust, you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense.", with the Exception; f4952 p. 4, Line 4g: "To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income (don’t enter more than the sum of lines 4b and 4e)." The reply's filing test has no disjunct for a positive line 4g election, so a return whose interest meets the exception but which elects on line 4g is told the form is not required (fixture classm.f8880.2.deepseek: f4952.line4g 971900, f4952.has_interest yes, no carryover, investment income above the interest; the project says required, the reply not). Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 1, Part I, line 2, "Disallowed investment interest expense from 2024 Form 4952, line 7". The reply takes f4952.prior_7 when f4952.carryover is true and zero otherwise, the project's amount; but it reads the input f4952.carryover where the project reads the gate line f4952.carryover_if_interest, which is f4952.carryover only when f4952.has_interest is yes and false otherwise (the interview asks the carryover only after the gate). So on completed returns where the gate is No the reply needs an answer the interview never asks (triage: 10 candidate-unknown on completed returns; the recorded witnesses name f4952.carryover); the earlier ruling that this difference cannot reach a return the interview produces holds for the values, not for the reply's need of the unasked answer. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/f4952.json`, pass c48595c59516; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 244 partial records): 2,366 of 2,446 in-scope comparisons agree; differences by kind {"candidate-unknown": 16, "project-refuses": 31, "project-unknown": 64}; the project refusals and unknowns, including those on completed returns, are at its cited gate f4952.alternative_allocation (f4952 pp. 1, 3–4: only the default allocation is supported) and f4952.unsupported, scope. No value differs. The project line is retained.
